title: Everything I Need I Get from You
description: A thrilling and riotous dive into the world of superfandom and the fangirls who shaped the social Internet.In 2014, on the side of a Los Angeles freeway, a One Direction fan erected a shrine in the spot where, a few hours earlier, Harry Styles had vomited. “It’s interesting for sure,” Styles said later, adding, “a little niche, maybe.” But what seemed niche to Styles was actually an irreverent signpost to an unfat...
